standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-argument (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: the A family is the argued semantic face of the conjugate field: definition, cut, derivation and return performed as readable argument on the reading surface

entities.governing_formation: one per scene, shaped and sequenced by the record's own operation; the record's load-bearing notation may appear as the formation's text source (e.g. A13 '/ = −/−', A18's eight-determination traversal)
entities.support_entities: only where the record's declared structure carries them (poles, offices, partners); quiet records keep one formation

text_layers.title_card: layer 1: kicker '<record id> · <CLAIM_STATUS>' + record title, left margin (x .033, width 340)
text_layers.relations: layer 2: the declared relation line as its own italic layer (x .033, y .26, width 290) — wraps fully in the left margin, clear of the field's left edge (E0 acceptance repair)
text_layers.body: layer 3: the record's own governing proposition and operation, compressed from the record only (x .033, y .50, width 600)

status_encoding.note: presentation-only encoding of the record's frontmatter claim_status; a repeated colour association is never a claimed source relation

variation_rules: per-scene variation is explicit and small: one or two field params, palette accent, formation shape/sequence
notation tokens appear only where the record's own notation is load-bearing
no ornament without an argumentative job; a quiet record stays quiet
the A′ conjugate family reuses this grammar under family-conjugate's material treatment — the two faces share one grammar
